name: dsh-skill-panel
description: Skills panel for DeepSeek Harness: an application-level nav row (official sidebar.panellist slot, order 5 — between Plugins and Schedule) opening a full center-column page that lists every skill this machine actually exposes (all six skill-root kinds, not just ~/.dsh/skills), shows why a skill is invisible (dropped:* / root-missing / disabled), and toggles a single skill by renaming only its entry file (SKILL.md -> SKILL.md.disabled). Read-only for project-level roots.
